title: The Capable nurse on the ward
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：capable　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 capable 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the driver wrote of ① a capable nurse on the ward in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② more capable than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the capable ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most capable nurse on the ward anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too capable to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the capable ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a capable hand with a needle, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as capable as the hand with a needle they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was capable or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something capable, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite capable; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the capable ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, on the same day, she wrote of another capable nurse on the ward in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more capable than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most capable hand with a needle in the whole station, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the capable ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 能干（前置定语 a capable nurse on the ward：1952 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件能干的护士）
B. adj. 能干／有能力（比较级 more capable than：文中两处，一处比病房的护士，一处比预想）
C. adj. 能干／有能力（最高级 the most capable：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 能干（表语 too capable to do：母亲觉得它太能干，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有能力（前置定语 a capable hand with a needle：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有能力的手）
F. adj. 有能力（同级比较 as capable as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩拿针的手相比）
G. adj. 有能力（后置定语 something capable：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有能力（受程度副词修饰 quite capable：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a capable nurse on the ward
the most capable nurse on the ward anybody
a capable hand with a needle
The most capable hand with a needle in

answers.why: capable 意为“能干”，1952 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件能干的护士”，此处作前置定语 a capable nurse on the ward。
capable 意为“能干”，此处用比较级 more capable than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
capable 意为“能干”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说它是车站里最能干的一件，故用最高级 the most capable nurse on the ward。
capable 意为“能干”，母亲认为这件东西“太能干了，谁也用不上”，too capable to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
capable 意为“有能力”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有能力的手”，此处作前置定语 a capable hand with a needle。
capable 意为“有能力”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩拿针的手一样有能力”，同级比较用 as capable as。
capable 意为“有能力”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“有能力的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something capable。
capable 意为“有能力”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当有能力”，quite 修饰原级 capable。
capable 意为“有能力”，1962 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要有能力”，故用比较级 more capable than。
capable 意为“有能力”，母亲 1964 年说的是“整个车站里最有能力的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most capable hand with a needle。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件能干的护士。（a capable nurse on the ward）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更能干。（more capable than …）
母亲觉得它太能干，谁也用不上。（too capable to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有能力的手。（a capable hand with a needle）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩拿针的手一样有能力。（as capable as …）
到了 1959 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件有能力的东西。（something capable）
answers: In 1952 the driver wrote of a capable nurse on the ward in the timetable.
Everybody said it was more capable than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too capable to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a capable hand with a needle.
He said nobody would call it as capable as the hand with a needle they had once had.
By 1959 the timetable asked for nothing but something capable.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 capable 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the driver wrote of a capable nurse on the ward in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most capable nurse on the ward in the station, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too capable to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a capable hand with a needle, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite capable, and everybody laughed.
The capable ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
